images.caption: Members of the Carrow Abbey Hunt. Depiction of a room at an inn or hunting box with seven members of the hunt waiting for their huntsman, James Mead, to join them. The picture has descended from one of the sitters, John Morse, seated on the table in the centre of the group, to the present owner, Christopher Morse.
